create.name: Lindsay Aya McGowen
create.bio:
Lindsay Aya McGowen is an intuitive channel based in Taos, New Mexico, who has worked with subtle energy and the unseen for about thirty years. Her early training ranged widely, through Polarity, cranial-sacral work, kinesiology, shamanism, sound and Matrix Energetics, and she later spent two years in the Divine University programme of Sri'ama Qala, completing initiations in Mexico and at temple sites in Egypt. She describes her work today as translating for councils of Ascended Masters, star beings, angels and nature spirits, and drawing on the Akashic Records and past lives to answer the questions a client brings.

Most people meet her through one-hour channelled readings, held in Taos, by phone or on Zoom, where the client sets the agenda and receives a recording afterwards. She also teaches people to open their own telepathic abilities, from foundation courses on meeting spirit guides to advanced classes on working with master teachers and the spirits of the land, and she will bring a workshop to groups who invite her. Her blog follows her pilgrimages to sacred sites in New Mexico, Mexico and southern England. In December 2026 she leads an online session on ascension for Kripalu.

courses.title: The Ascension Conversation
courses.description: A ninety-minute live online session for Kripalu. The first half looks at what she calls an organic ascension and how this period of change touches personal and shared life; in the second half she channels a council of master teachers to answer participants' questions.

courses.title: Individual Channeled Readings
courses.description: One-hour readings in Taos, by phone or on Zoom, in which she channels guidance on whatever the client asks about, from relationships and work to past lives. Each session is recorded and the file is emailed afterwards.

courses.title: Telepathic Trainings
courses.description: Her courses on reawakening telepathic ability, starting with a foundation workshop on meeting your spirit guides and moving on to classes on working with master teachers and with the spirits of the land. Most run live online; new dates are to be announced.

courses.title: Custom Group Workshops
courses.description: Workshops she brings to groups on request, either on opening your telepathic channels to guides and angels or on listening to the land and its nature spirits. No prior experience is needed.
